liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Hank Harrsion speaks**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]
- **Alabama Getaway - aired on radio show, left in for historical accuracy, not complete**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]
- **Pig Pen Interview**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]
- **Hank Harrsion speaks and interviews Phil Lesh**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]
- **Hank Harrsion speaks and interviews Tom Constanten**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]
- **Hank Harrsion speaks and interviews Paul Foster, Original Merry Prankster**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]
- **Hank Harrsion speaks and interviews Mike Ferguson, whom Hank knew for 20 years**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]
- **Hank Harrsion speaks and interviews Gary Duncan of Quicksilver Messenger Service in Hawaii with Nicky Hopkins on piano in the background**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [2]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-01-01.145954.waddell.flac1644** (recommended): source not stated; 11 songs; 62 min [1]

## Around the show

- Material is a set of 1960s and 1970s interviews that Hank Harrison put together and introduced in 1980 [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-01-01.145954.waddell.flac1644**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Unknown; source: Unknown [1]. Also: Harrison refers to the compilation as being on a C60 cassette; the recording is split into Side A and Side B; The source was provided by Jason Chastain [1]
